output: The Inca Empire was in South America, centered in Peru.
The Middle Ages, or medieval period, was from about 500 to 1500 CE.
Pyramids were monumental tombs built by ancient Egyptians.
Newton was a physicist who discovered gravity and the laws of motion.
The American Revolution was when 13 colonies gained independence from Britain.
Pharaohs were the kings of ancient Egypt.
Magellan led the first expedition to circumnavigate the globe.
Julius Caesar was a Roman general and dictator.
Socrates was a Greek philosopher, teacher of Plato.
The Industrial Revolution shifted manufacturing from hand to machine, starting in Britain.
